title: Color Jump Switch
description: Tap to bounce a glowing ball upward and pass cleanly ONLY through segments matching your current neon color—one mistake shatters everything!
controls: Tap to hop upward through rotating color wheels matching your ball's hue while collecting stars.

zh-CN.title: 色彩跳跃挑战
zh-CN.description: 全球亿级极简神作色彩跳跃 Color Switch：轻点跳跃只穿同色旋转色环，节奏精准魔性到停不下来！
zh-CN.controls: 点击屏幕控制彩球向上弹跳，精准穿过与小球颜色相同的旋转色带收集星星。
